# jspdf-md-renderer — AI Agent Reference

## Package
- npm: jspdf-md-renderer
- Version: latest
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/JeelGajera/jspdf-md-renderer

## What it does
Renders Markdown content directly into jsPDF PDF documents with full custom styling options.
Built on top of jsPDF with marked.js for markdown parsing and jspdf-autotable for table rendering.

## Installation
jspdf, jspdf-autotable and marked are PEER dependencies (since 4.3).
```
npm install jspdf-md-renderer jspdf jspdf-autotable marked
```
Supported peers: jspdf ^2 || ^3 || ^4, jspdf-autotable ^3 || ^4 || ^5, marked ^18

## Core API

### MdTextRender(doc, text, options)
Renders markdown into a jsPDF doc.
- doc: jsPDF instance
- text: string — raw markdown content
- options: RenderOption (see below)
- Returns: Promise<RenderResult> (since 4.3; previously Promise<void>)

### MdTextParser(text)
Parses markdown into structured tokens.
- text: string — raw markdown content
- Returns: Promise<ParsedElement[]>

## RenderOption — Full Options Reference

### Minimal configuration (4.3+)
Only font.regular is required. Everything else has a default.
```javascript
{ page: { margin: { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 20, left: 20 } },
  font: { regular: { name: 'helvetica', style: 'normal' } } }
```

### cursor (optional)
- cursor.x: number — Starting X position
- cursor.y: number — Starting Y position
- Defaults to the top-left of the content area implied by page.margin

### page
- page.format: string | number[] — Page format (default: 'a4')
- page.unit: string — Unit: 'mm', 'pt', 'px', 'in'
- page.orientation: string — 'portrait'/'p' or 'landscape'/'l' (default: 'p')
- page.margin: { top, right, bottom, left } — RECOMMENDED. See below
- page.maxContentWidth: number — DEPRECATED. Content column width (default: 190)
- page.maxContentHeight: number — DEPRECATED. Absolute Y of the content bottom,
  NOT a height (default: 277)
- page.lineSpace: number — Spacing between elements (default: 3)
- page.defaultLineHeightFactor: number — Line height factor (default: 1.4)
- page.defaultFontSize: number — Body font size (default: 11)
- page.defaultTitleFontSize: number — Heading font size (default: 14)
- page.topmargin: number — DEPRECATED. Y where content starts (default: 10)
- page.xpading: number — DEPRECATED. Left edge of content column (default: 10)
- page.xmargin: number — DEPRECATED. Header/footer horizontal margin (default: 10)
- page.indent: number — Nested list/blockquote indent per level (default: 8)

### font
- font.regular: { name: string, style: string } — REQUIRED. Body font
- font.bold: { name: string, style: string } — default: helvetica bold
- font.italic / font.boldItalic — default: helvetica italic / bolditalic
- font.code: { name: string, style: string } — default: courier normal
- font.light — DEPRECATED, never read by the renderer

### content (optional)
- content.textAlignment: 'left' | 'right' | 'center' | 'justify'

### codespan (optional)
- codespan.backgroundColor: string — Inline code bg (default: '#EEEEEE')
- codespan.padding: number — Inline code padding (default: 0.8)
- codespan.showBackground: boolean — Show background (default: true)
- codespan.fontSizeScale: number — Code font scale (default: 0.88)

### link (optional)
- link.linkColor: [number, number, number] — RGB link color

### page.margin (recommended)
- page.margin: { top, right, bottom, left } — derives the content area from the
  document page size. Omitted sides default to 10. Replaces manual
  maxContentWidth/maxContentHeight/topmargin/xpading/xmargin, which are
  deprecated but still honoured and still win when both are given.

### Return value
- MdTextRender resolves to { endY, startPage, pageCount, warnings,
  droppedNodes, violations }
- warnings report anything that could not be drawn, each with code, message,
  context and droppedNodes
- options.silent suppresses console output; options.onWarning receives each one

### components (optional)
- components: { heading, paragraph, list, listItem, blockquote, code, table,
  image, hr } — replace or decorate any block renderer
- each receives a context with doc, element, indentLevel, indent, x, y,
  maxWidth, store, options, next() and render()
- next() runs the built-in renderer; an override that throws falls back to it

### registerFont
- registerFont(doc, { family, variants: { normal, bold, italic, bolditalic },
  fileNames?, onWarning? })
- variants.normal is required; missing styles fall back to it within the family
- accepts raw base64 or a data: URI
- returns { family, registered, font } where font drops into RenderOption.font
- `registered` lists only the variants jsPDF actually accepted

### table (optional)
- Passes through to jspdf-autotable UserOptions

### image (optional)
- image.defaultAlign: 'left' | 'center' | 'right' (default: 'left')

### Callbacks
- onWarning: (warning: RenderWarning) => void — Optional. Fires per warning.
- pageBreakHandler: (doc: jsPDF) => void — Optional. Called when new page is added.
- endCursorYHandler: (y: number) => void — Optional and DEPRECATED since 4.3.
  Use the returned result's endY, which carries the same value.

### Warning codes (RenderWarningCode)
TOKEN_CONVERSION_FAILED, UNSUPPORTED_ELEMENT, IMAGE_LOAD_FAILED,
IMAGE_RENDER_FAILED, IMAGE_ATTRS_IGNORED, IMAGE_SIZE_UNKNOWN, TABLE_SKIPPED,
TABLE_CALLBACK_FAILED, TABLE_POSITION_UNKNOWN, CODE_BLOCK_OVERFLOW,
CONTENT_DROPPED, COMPONENT_OVERRIDE_FAILED, SECURITY_CALLBACK_FAILED,
SSRF_CHECKS_UNAVAILABLE

## Supported Markdown Elements
- headings (# through ######)
- paragraphs (plain text blocks)
- line breaks (<br> tags)
- lists (ordered 1., unordered -, nested, mixed)
- horizontal rules (---, ***, ___)
- bold (**text** or __text__)
- italic (*text* or _text_)
- bold-italic (***text***)
- strikethrough (~~text~~)
- escaped characters (\*, \_)
- code blocks (fenced ```lang blocks)
- inline code (`code`)
- links ([text](url))
- blockquotes (> text)
- images (![alt](url) with optional attributes)
- tables (GFM pipe tables, with column alignment from the delimiter row)
- reference links ([text][ref] with [ref]: url definitions)

## Image Attribute Syntax
```
![alt](url){width=200 height=150 align=center}
```
Attributes: width/w (px), height/h (px), align (left|center|right)
Sizing: width-only or height-only auto-calculates the other from aspect ratio.
Images exceeding page width are scaled down proportionally.

## UMD / Browser Usage
Load scripts in order: marked → jspdf → jspdf-autotable → jspdf-md-renderer
Access via: window.jspdf.jsPDF and window.JspdfMdRenderer.MdTextRender

## Basic Example
```javascript
import { jsPDF } from 'jspdf';
import { MdTextRender } from 'jspdf-md-renderer';

const doc = new jsPDF({ unit: 'mm', format: 'a4' });
const result = await MdTextRender(doc, '# Hello World', {
  page: { margin: { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 20, left: 20 } },
  font: { regular: { name: 'helvetica', style: 'normal' } },
});
if (result.warnings.length) console.warn(result.warnings);
doc.save('output.pdf');
```

## Legacy Example (pre-4.3 explicit geometry, still supported)
```javascript
await MdTextRender(doc, '# Hello World', {
  cursor: { x: 10, y: 10 },
  page: { maxContentWidth: 190, maxContentHeight: 277, lineSpace: 1.5,
    defaultLineHeightFactor: 1.2, defaultFontSize: 12, defaultTitleFontSize: 14,
    topmargin: 10, xpading: 10, xmargin: 10, indent: 10 },
  font: { bold: { name: 'helvetica', style: 'bold' },
    regular: { name: 'helvetica', style: 'normal' } },
  endCursorYHandler: (y) => console.log('End Y:', y),
});
```
